title: Domestic: ex-partner banging on the door

caller.persona: frightened, whispering, close to tears, keeps checking the window
caller.openingLine: Please, you have to send someone, he's outside banging on my door again. He's not supposed to come here. Please hurry.
dontKnowLines: I don't know, I can't see from here.
I don't know... please just send someone.

incident.summaryTruth: Caller {{callerName}}, {{callerAge}}, is inside her home at {{address}}, {{town}}, BN21 3EX. Her ex-husband {{suspectName}} is outside banging on the front door and shouting. A non-molestation order is in place against him. He has been drinking. He has not got inside. No weapons seen. Caller's 8 year old granddaughter Millie is in the house. {{suspectFirst}} arrived on foot about five minutes ago.

facts.label: Address
facts.beat: {{address}}, in {{town}}. BN21 3EX. Please write it down, please.

facts.label: Offender's name
facts.beat: It's {{suspectFirst}}. My ex-husband, {{suspectName}}. There's a court order, he's not allowed within a hundred metres.

facts.label: Non-molestation order in place
facts.beat: There's a non-molestation order against him, from March. He's breaching it right now just by being here.

facts.label: Whether he has got inside
facts.beat: He's still outside, the door's held but he keeps hammering on it. He's screaming through the letterbox.

facts.label: Weapons
facts.beat: I don't think so, I haven't seen anything in his hands. He's been drinking though, I can hear it in his voice.

facts.label: Child in the house
facts.beat: My granddaughter's here, Millie, she's only eight. She's hiding upstairs. That's why I'm whispering.

facts.label: How and when he arrived
facts.beat: About five minutes. He walked up, I saw him coming up the road. No car, he lost his licence.

escalations.text: Second call from the informant. He has picked up a kitchen knife from the block by the door and is shouting through the letterbox.
